import re

from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

WRITE_ALLOWED = ("wiki/", "index.md", "log.md")

class Vault:
    REQUIRED = ("CLAUDE.md", "index.md", "log.md", "raw", "wiki")

    def __init__(self, root: Path):
        self.root = root
        if not root.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"\nNo such directory: {root}\n  Pass --vault DIR or set VAULT_PATH.\n")
        missing = [name for name in self.REQUIRED if not (root / name).exists()]
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"\n{root} does not look like a wiki vault.\n"
                f"  Missing: {', '.join(missing)}\n"
                f"  A vault needs: {', '.join(self.REQUIRED)}\n"
                "  CLAUDE.md is the schema and is sent to the model as the system prompt.\n"
            )

    def read(self, rel: str) -> str:
        path = self.root / rel
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

    def raw_sources(self) -> list:
        """Markdown under raw/, excluding assets and raw/'s own README.

        Only `raw/README.md` is skipped -- that one describes the folder itself.
        A project's README is a legitimate source, and blanket-skipping the name
        silently dropped seven of them from raw/Programming/.
        """
        found = []
        for path in sorted((self.root / "raw").rglob("*.md")):
            rel = path.relative_to(self.root).as_posix()
            if "/assets/" in rel or rel.lower() == "raw/readme.md":
                continue
            found.append(rel)
        return found

    def ingested_paths(self) -> set:
        """source_path values already recorded in wiki/sources/ frontmatter."""
        done = set()
        for path in (self.root / "wiki" / "sources").glob("*.md"):
            match = re.search(r"^source_path:\s*(.+)$", path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.M)
            if match:
                done.add(match.group(1).strip().strip('"').replace("\\", "/"))
        return done

    def pending(self) -> list:
        done = self.ingested_paths()
        return [rel for rel in self.raw_sources() if rel not in done]

    def wiki_inventory(self) -> list:
        """Every wiki page as (relative path, title) for the relevance pass."""
        pages = []
        for path in sorted((self.root / "wiki").rglob("*.md")):
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            match = re.search(r"^title:\s*(.+)$", text, re.M)
            title = match.group(1).strip() if match else path.stem
            pages.append((path.relative_to(self.root).as_posix(), title))
        return pages

    def safe_write(self, rel: str, content: str) -> Path:
        rel = rel.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
        if not rel.startswith(WRITE_ALLOWED):
            raise ValueError(f"refusing to write outside wiki/: {rel}")
        target = (self.root / rel).resolve()
        if self.root.resolve() not in target.parents and target != self.root.resolve():
            raise ValueError(f"path escapes the vault: {rel}")

        # An "update" replaces a page wholesale, so a model that drops a section
        # loses it silently. Keep the previous version; a knowledge base has no
        # tests to catch that for you.
        if target.exists():
            stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
            backup = self.root / ".ingest-backup" / stamp / rel
            backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            backup.write_text(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")

        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return target

def validate(plan: dict, source_rel: str) -> list:
    """Reject a plan that would break the vault's own rules."""
    problems = []
    pages = plan.get("pages") or []
    if not pages:
        problems.append("no pages returned")

    source_pages = [p for p in pages if p.get("path", "").startswith("wiki/sources/")]
    if not source_pages:
        problems.append("no wiki/sources/ page")
    for page in source_pages:
        if f"source_path: {source_rel}" not in (page.get("content") or ""):
            problems.append(f"{page['path']}: frontmatter is missing `source_path: {source_rel}`")

    for page in pages:
        path = (page.get("path") or "").replace("\\", "/")
        if not path.startswith("wiki/"):
            problems.append(f"refuses to write outside wiki/: {path}")
        if not (page.get("content") or "").strip():
            problems.append(f"{path}: empty content")
        # The schema says bare page names; a path inside a wikilink resolves to
        # the wrong note in Obsidian, which is how the existing pages went wrong.
        # Only paths are rejected here: [[CLAUDE.md]] names the schema file in
        # the vault root and is a legitimate link, so a blanket ban on `.md`
        # would reject good output.
        for bad in re.findall(r"\[\[[^\]]*/[^\]]*\]\]", page.get("content") or ""):
            problems.append(f"{path}: wikilink with a path, should be a bare page name: {bad}")
    return problems


def repair_wikilinks(plan: dict) -> list:
    """Fix the two link mistakes that have an unambiguous correction.

    Rejecting a whole plan over one bad link is expensive: it threw away a
    12-chunk condensation of a 277 KB source, which cost more than everything
    else in that run combined. Repair what is certain, still reject what is not.

      [[wiki/entities/Foo]]   -> [[Foo]]        a path; the schema forbids it
      [[RFIC / FEM / AFE]]    -> [[RFIC]] / [[FEM]] / [[AFE]]
                                                an enumeration; Obsidian would
                                                read the slashes as folders
    """
    repaired = []

    def fix(match):
        inner = match.group(1).strip()
        if "/" not in inner:
            return match.group(0)
        if inner.startswith(("wiki/", "raw/")) or inner.endswith(".md"):
            fixed = f"[[{Path(inner).stem}]]"
        elif " / " in inner:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in inner.split("/") if p.strip()]
            fixed = " / ".join(f"[[{p}]]" for p in parts)
        else:
            return match.group(0)  # genuinely ambiguous; let validate reject it
        repaired.append(f"{inner} -> {fixed}")
        return fixed

    for page in plan.get("pages") or []:
        content = page.get("content") or ""
        new = re.sub(r"\[\[([^\]|#]+)\]\]", fix, content)
        if new != content:
            page["content"] = new
    return repaired


def ensure_conflicts_visible(plan: dict) -> bool:
    """Guarantee every reported contradiction also appears on a page.

    The model is told to do this, and mostly does. When it does not, the
    conflict would exist only in log.md -- which nobody reads in Obsidian, and
    which is how 3 conflicts ended up invisible across 192 pages. Rejecting the
    whole plan would throw away good work, so the marker is added here instead.
    """
    notes = [str(n).strip() for n in (plan.get("contradictions") or []) if str(n).strip()]
    if not notes:
        return False

    pages = plan.get("pages") or []
    if any("⚠️" in (page.get("content") or "") for page in pages):
        return False

    # Prefer an entity/concept page -- that is where a reader meets the claim.
    target = next((p for p in pages
                   if p.get("path", "").startswith(("wiki/entities/", "wiki/concepts/"))),
                  pages[0] if pages else None)
    if target is None:
        return False

    block = "\n\n## ⚠️ 待裁決的衝突\n\n" + "\n".join(f"⚠️ {note}" for note in notes) + "\n"
    target["content"] = target["content"].rstrip() + block
    return True

def update_index(vault: Vault, entries: list) -> None:
    """Insert lines under the right '## Section' heading, skipping duplicates."""
    lines = vault.read("index.md").splitlines()
    for entry in entries:
        section = (entry.get("section") or "").strip()
        line = (entry.get("line") or "").strip()
        if not section or not line or line in lines:
            continue
        heading = next(
            (i for i, text in enumerate(lines)
             if text.startswith("## ") and section.lower() in text.lower()), None)
        if heading is None:
            lines += ["", f"## {section}", line]
            continue
        insert = heading + 1
        while insert < len(lines) and not lines[insert].startswith("## "):
            insert += 1
        while insert > heading + 1 and not lines[insert - 1].strip():
            insert -= 1
        lines.insert(insert, line)
    vault.safe_write("index.md", "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")


def append_log(vault: Vault, plan: dict) -> None:
    title = Path(plan["_source"]).stem
    body = (plan.get("log_body") or "").rstrip()
    block = f"\n## [{date.today().isoformat()}] ingest | {title}\n{body}\n"
    for note in plan.get("contradictions") or []:
        block += f"- ⚠️ {note}\n"
    path = vault.root / "log.md"
    path.write_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip() + "\n" + block, encoding="utf-8")
